title: Upgrading Accident and Emergency Departments in All Private and Public Hospitals to Enable Them to Handle Severe and Multiple Trauma Cases
what_it_is: Upgrading Accident and Emergency Departments in All Private and Public Hospitals to Enable Them to Handle Severe and Multiple Trauma Cases

sections.label: Public hospital emergency and trauma care
sections.summary: MOH states eight public hospital A&E departments give adequate coverage, private hospitals lack full emergency and trauma services, and about 180 Emergency Medicine specialists and 240 general surgeons exist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Public hospitals must also fulfill the Ministry of Health's (MOH's) standards of trauma care.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Overall, the eight public hospital A&E departments, spread out across Singapore, provide adequate coverage to cater to emergency services in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Currently, private hospitals are not configured to provide the full range of emergency and trauma services required to manage all life-threatening emergencies or situations involving patients with multiple or serious injuries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Over the last four years, MOH has been collaborating with Raffles Hospital for the management of non-life threatening and urgent Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) ambulance cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: MOH carefully manages the training pipelines for emergency medicine and surgical specialists to ensure that there are sufficient capabilities to meet national needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Currently, there are about 180 Emergency Medicine specialists and 240 general surgeons in Singapore.

sections.label: Specialist training pipeline increase
sections.summary: The number of specialists in the training pipeline will increase by about 43% over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In addition, the number of specialists who are in the pipeline and whom we are training currently, will increase by about 43% over the next five years.
